norm: owner-weighted global L2, matching p06_structured_global.numerics._statistics/_compact_statistics (owner physical volume weight); the stored-owner-volume L2 is also reported (P05N convention)
wall_exterior_contract: recovered Neumann trace (Dirichlet: prescribed trace) as the characteristic wall solve's boundary_trace; the physical-wall characteristic correction is zero by construction (see p06n_catalogue.json)
gate: N-R global L2 order >= 1.8 on both intervals (32->48, 48->64), for every nonconstant case (main, held-out and dirichlet_rich) in gated_cases, equation in gated_equations, candidate in {centered, U}, on the total term; material/remainder and N-D reported ungated. The held-out field is evaluated only in the campaign run, never during preparation. Constant controls: |action| <= constant_action_absolute_maximum.
acceptance: returned unchanged, no interpretation performed here; the user decides pass/fail from the reported gate table
